title: Going back from an invoice keeps the Sales Type selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today has at least one invoiced split work order with Labor {Sales-rep-A} and Parts {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with Show Unassigned on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Select only "Parts" in the Sales Type filter.
  2. Expand {Sales-rep-B}.
  3. Open the invoice from {Sales-rep-B}'s row.
  4. Press the browser's back button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the filter reads "Sales Type: Parts".
  • Step 2: {Sales-rep-B}'s invoice rows show.
  • Step 3: the invoice opens.
  • Step 4: the report returns with "Sales Type: Parts" still selected, {Sales-rep-B} still expanded and the same scroll position, without a full reload.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Sales By Representative spec, S12-R3a: “Pressing the browser back button from either destination returns the user to the report with all state intact — date range, sales type, invoice status, location, Show Unassigned, every rep's expansion state, and scroll position — exactly as they were. Back-navigation must not trigger a full report reload. (This differs from a deliberate page reload, which restores the persisted filters/columns/sort but resets expansion and scroll — Story 23.)”
